package.description: Single executable application bundler for Windows

en-US.description: Single executable application bundler for Windows
en-US.longDescription:
ExeBundle packages Windows executables and their dependencies into a single
self-contained .exe file. At runtime, files are extracted and the application
is launched automatically. Supports caching for instant repeated launches.
en-US.name: ExeBundle
